text: Celeste Marchbanks wants Haverbrook Tickets to 'ship safely and know when it breaks' -- but that's an intention, not yet something you can build or test.
The first half: every push to GitHub should trigger an automated, tested, scanned deployment to a real environment -- no more manual pushes from a laptop.
The second half is harder: page the team when a customer actually fails to complete a purchase -- not just when an HTTP status code looks bad.
checkout-api could return a healthy 200 while VoltPay quietly fails to charge the customer -- that's exactly the gap this requirement is written to catch.
Next: scoping V1 honestly -- what this project actually ships, and what gets deferred.
